title: /about and /spaces were titled with one generic word

source.ref: found 2026-10-05 by the scan-seven SEO/GEO finders (26-agent fan-out), confirmed by hand against the tree

detail: FOUND 2026-10-05 (scan seven, seo-content finder). 'About' and 'Spaces' through the root template became 'About · Frequency' and 'Spaces · Frequency', which no query contains. CLOSED 2026-10-05: 'About the Community Collective' and 'Spaces for businesses, studios and organizations'; neither repeats the brand, so check:seo's double-branding rule holds.

verify.cmd: node -e 'const fs=require("fs");const a=fs.readFileSync("app/(marketing)/about/page.tsx","utf8"),b=fs.readFileSync("app/(marketing)/spaces/page.tsx","utf8");if(/title: \x27About\x27,/.test(a)||/title: \x27Spaces\x27,/.test(b)){console.error("SCAN-678: /about and /spaces are titled with one generic word, which the template turns into About · Frequency and Spaces · Frequency: no query matches either.");process.exit(1)}'
verify.note: Fails on main before this change; passes with it.
